title: Prompt Template Slides - Add Structure and Control
description: Prompt template are structured way to communicate to LLM and guide it to produce desired output. Using proompt template you can fine tune LLM ouput by guiding or adding constraint. Prompt templates can also reduce the need for fine tuning model. Prompt templates can help LLM to generalize better.
